latency.model: server span - CPU parts (/ r_c) - DB exec = a x statements + b x commits + c x publishes (no intercept)
latency.unit: ms wall time per statement / commit / publish, instrumented configuration (sampler 0.1)
latency.commitUnit: per (request, service) with writes (one transaction per handler)
latency.headline: perWritingHandler

dbLatencyPerAccess.note: for latency the DB part of an access is its exec time per call (scans run with parallel workers: exec < DB CPU); sharedBlksPerCallMax > 1000 = a large scan
